bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 20.2K followers. 39 members in The Profit Society.
beats.text: You're verified, you post almost every day, and TPS is rated 5.0 at $150 a month. But Trading Simplified, the program that teaches the whole system, has no page that sells it before someone gets on your calendar.

beats.title: 200+ traders coached. 19 five-star reviews.
beats.text: Your YouTube says you've coached over 200 traders, TPS has 19 reviews at 5.0, and posts like “Comment TRADE” already pull people into your DMs. The demand is there. What's missing is a filter before it reaches you.

beats.title: “Apply Now” books a free call with anyone.
beats.text: On your Trading Simplified page, both “Apply Now” and “Get Started” go straight to the free “Is Trading For Me?” Calendly. Nobody answers a single question first, so you only find out on the call who's ready and who isn't.

beats.title: “I already take calls.” Now they're the right calls.
beats.text: Keep the free call. Put one page and a seven-question application in front of it, so the people who book already know what Trading Simplified is, trade money they can afford to lose, and are ready to invest. Same calendar, better conversations.
beats.quote: “You don’t need to trade all day. You need a plan that tells you when to trade, what to look for, and when to walk away.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and how much time you really have each day.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Hansome

preCallEmails.subject: You don't need to trade all day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

I have a newborn and a 2-year-old. I don't have the time to sit in front of the charts all day, and you don't need to either.

What you need is a plan that tells you when to trade, what to look for, and when to walk away.

That's what Trading Simplified is built on. On the call we'll look at where your plan breaks today.

Hansome

preCallEmails.subject: "I'm already in TPS"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then you've seen how we trade
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know the live sessions and the community.

Trading Simplified is the full system behind them: structure, entries and exits, risk, and the psychology work, with your own journal, so you can trade it without watching someone else.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Hansome

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading, and your schedule, to look like in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Hansome

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Hansome's team
preCallEmails.body:

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Hansome
